narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our lesson on Trigonometric Ratios! In this video, we'll dive into the fundamental relationships between the sides and angles of a right-angled triangle. You'll learn about the six main trigonometric ratios: sine, cosine, tangent, and their reciprocals. We'll also walk through examples to show you how to apply these ratios to solve problems. By the end, you'll have a solid understanding of how trigonometry helps us measure and understand triangles. Let's begin!
